title: M-A092226-01 Resource Entity (RE) and Transmission Service Provider (TSP) winter weather preparedness workshop in person or by WebEx

documents.text:
Market Notice Details

To:

Notice_Operations@lists.ercot.com

Sent:

9/22/26, 12:02 PM

Subject:

M-A092226-01 Resource Entity (RE) and Transmission Service Provider (TSP) winter weather preparedness workshop in person or by WebEx

NOTICE DATE:
 September 22, 2026

NOTICE TYPE:
 M-A092226-01 Operations

SHORT DESCRIPTION:
 Resource Entity (RE) and Transmission Service Provider (TSP) winter weather preparedness workshop in person or by WebEx

INTENDED AUDIENCE:
 Resource Entities and Transmission Service Providers

DAYS AFFECTED:
 October 22, 2026, 9:00 a.m. to 12:30 p.m.

LONG DESCRIPTION:
 ERCOT will host a Winter Weather Preparedness Workshop for RE and TSP personnel on October 22, 2026, from 9:00 a.m. to 12:30 p.m., at 8000 Metropolis Drive (Building E), Suite 100, Austin, TX 78744. The workshop will cover: (1) requirements of the Public Utility Commission of Texas (PUCT) Weather Emergency Preparedness Rule, 16 Texas Administrative Code (TAC) 25.55; (2) ERCOT's associated weatherization inspection checklist; (3) submitting a Declaration of Weather Preparedness (DoWP) through the Weatherization & Inspection Market Participant Portal; and (4) other relevant information for winter weather preparedness. Please see the ERCOT 
meeting calendar
 for additional information.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:
 Meeting information is posted on the ERCOT 
meeting calendar
.

CONTACT:
 If you have any questions, please contact your ERCOT Account Manager. You may also call the general ERCOT Client Services phone number at (512) 248-3900 or contact ERCOT Client Services via email at 
ClientServices@ercot.com
.

If you are receiving email from a public ERCOT distribution list that you no longer wish to receive, please follow this link in order to unsubscribe from this list: 
http://lists.ercot.com
.
